# HairyTalesBeauty

> Premium custom wigs, braided wigs, and wholesale hair deals based in Ghana, shipping worldwide.

HairyTalesBeauty offers handcrafted lace wigs, braided wigs, frontal units, closures, locs, twists, and bundles. Custom orders and wholesale pricing available.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured products, collections, and offers.
- [Shop](/shop): Full product catalog with filters by category, hair type, length, and color.
- [Custom Braided Wigs](/custom-braided-wigs): Request a made-to-order braided wig.
- [Wholesale Deals](/wholesale-deals): Bulk pricing and quote requests for resellers.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach customer support.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about products, sizing, shipping, and care.
- [Shipping Info](/shipping): Delivery times, rates, and supported countries.
- [Returns & Exchanges](/returns): Return policy and process.
